title: Cross-session transfer of a unified neural population decoder
scientific_question: Does cross-source neural population pretraining improve adaptation to genuinely held sessions across the complete four-source158-session paper scope at a fixed adaptation budget?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

paper.title: A Unified, Scalable Framework for Neural Population Decoding

official_code.pipeline_commit_resolution: UNRESOLVED: the observed GitHub git/trees/main response identifies a tree object. No commit-to-tree join, current commit identity or historical paper commit is asserted.

complete_scope: Complete four-source POYO-1 pretraining/transfer claim and its full held-session adaptation curve. POYO-MP on Perich alone is not a replacement. Freeze all 158 historical sessions or hold reproduction if contemporary conversions do not map completely.

outputs: Complete held-session decoding R2 and adaptation-budget curves
Pretrained versus from-scratch comparison at matched data/compute budget
baselines: Ridge and recurrent decoder under matched training data
reference.panel: Paper's full multi-dataset decoding and transfer experiments; exact panel/config map remains required.

prospective_improvement.endpoint: Higher macro-session R2 at a fixed adaptation trial budget on sessions excluded from pretraining, with adaptation compute and calibration reported.
prospective_improvement.heldout_unit: Whole session, plus animal-held sensitivity when the source supports it. No unit/session identifier lookup into held targets.
controls: Pretraining contamination manifest including all source versions

resources.basis: Observed three-family archives total about 90.5 GB before Flint and extraction; full multi-session pretraining/transfer grid is substantial. Estimates do not authorize a reduced single-source run.

remaining_gates: Complete 158-session historical manifest and preprocessing identity
Complete original training/transfer configs and modern-source equivalence
overlap: Shares the Sabes acquisition family with NEURAL-023/024 and DPAD/DFINE; Churchland motor data are related to NEURAL-017/018/019 (MC_Maze), but full acquisition equivalence needs manifest joins. NEURAL-020 is Area2, not established as the same acquisition. New endpoint is full multi-source pretraining and novel-session adaptation.
participant_inputs: Complete published four-source spike/kinematic scope (158 sessions,7 primates,27373 units,>100h as paper targets), with full authenticated source-version/session joins; same adaptation trials and train/dev information in both arms. No Perich-only or POYO-MP substitution.

machine_output.predictions: All held-session behavior trajectories for each adaptation budget and pretrained/from-scratch/baseline model, keyed by source/animal/session/segment.
machine_output.tables: Full decodingR2 and adaptation-budget curves, session macro and per-source/per-animal results, calibration and complete compute accounting.
machine_output.artifacts: Pretraining membership manifest, model provenance/checkpoints, source data mappings, exact adaptation splits/configs and all failures.

scoring: Macro-sessionR2 at frozen adaptation trial budgets with every source and animal reported. Compare same architecture from scratch and competent ridge/recurrent references under matched tuning/adaptation resources; historical reproduction and prospective unseen-session improvement separate.
protected_split: Entire held sessions excluded from pretraining, normalization and tuning, with animal-held sensitivity where supported. Keep overlapping time windows together and never use unit/session IDs to look up held answers. Public checkpoints require contamination audit.
comparators: POYO, matched from-scratch architecture, ridge and recurrent decoder; no-pretraining and shuffled neuron/session identifiers, equal total budget.
distinctness: Full multi-source pretraining/adaptation central contribution, distinct from single-session latent movement information, day drift and missingness/nonlinear-placement tasks. Four source datasets and multiple adaptation arms count as one task.
pipeline_identity: The four exact pipeline blobs and pipeline_tree_sha are preserved in provenance. Associated pipeline commit remains null/unresolved; no tree-as-commit claim.
